Name: Don't Stop Me Now Redux
Author: space3045
Description:
[b][size=4]Don't Stop Me Now Redux[/size][/b]

No more stopping for any action. This is a continuation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10941]Shockah's Don't Stop Me Now[/url], picking up where the original left off.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/10941/10941-1644010088-1390735935.gif[/img]

[b][u]WHAT IT DOES[/u][/b]

By default, Stardew Valley locks you in place while you swing a tool, fire a weapon, aim a slingshot, or pick something up. This mod lets you keep moving (and optionally keep facing the mouse/movement direction) through all of it, with fine-grained control over exactly which actions are allowed to override the freeze.

[b][u]FEATURES[/u][/b]

- Move while swinging tools (axe, hoe, watering can, pickaxe, etc.)
- Move while swinging melee weapons
- Move while using a weapon's special attack
- Move while aiming a slingshot
- Move while charging up a tool (the "power-up" hold)
- Move while picking up items - harvesting crops by hand or picking up forage/ground items no longer freezes you in place
- Optional reduced movement speed while any of the above is active, with a configurable multiplier
- Keep facing the mouse cursor (or controller stick) while swinging tools, weapons, and special attacks, instead of getting stuck facing whichever direction you were walking when you clicked

[b][u]WHAT'S CHANGED FROM THE ORIGINAL[/u][/b]

This fork focuses entirely on fixing bugs in the 1.6 rewrite of the original mod, without changing what it fundamentally does:

- Support for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1089]Fast Animations[/url].
- Fixed a bug that causes a single-frame speed spike.
- Fixed movement being allowed during unrelated frozen states.
- Added a new, independent "Move while picking up items" setting.
- Fixed facing direction not updating for a weapon's special attack.

[b][u]REQUIREMENTS[/u][/b]

- Kokoro (Shockah's core library mod) - [b]required[/b], install it alongside this mod
- Generic Mod Config Menu - optional

[b][u]COMPATIBILITY[/u][/b]

- Compatible with Fast Animations.
- Should be compatible with anything the original Don't Stop Me Now was compatible with. Do not install this alongside the original Don't Stop Me Now!

[b][u]CREDITS[/u][/b]

All original design and the vast majority of the code is [b][u]Shockah's[/u][/b] work — this is a fork of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10941]Don't Stop Me Now[/url], used and modified under its Apache License 2.0. Please go support the original and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Shockah/mods]Shockah's other mods[/url]
